correctness.rationale: PASS. For any simplicial sphere endomorphism without invariant simplex, a fixed realization point would force an invariant carrier simplex; therefore it is fixed-point-free. Lefschetz on S² gives degree −1, forcing a nonzero-degree simplicial self-map. Every target triangle then has a nondegenerate source preimage; equal facet counts imply bijection on triangles and surjectivity on vertices, so an automorphism. Euler e=3v−6 and minimum vertex degree three imply unique triangulations for v=4,5, and two for v=6 (octahedron and a one-face subdivision of the triangular bipyramid). Explicit free automorphisms exclude the first three; the four automorphisms of the displayed six-vertex complex all fix a vertex or the edge {4,5}. Independently enumerated all 6^6=46,656 maps and obtained 6,658 simplicial endomorphisms with 0 fixed-simplex-free cases; independent finite corroboration, not replacement for global proof.
